bar.idle: Lock-In · Make time for what matters
setup.title: One thing. Your full attention.
setup.deepwork: A single, uninterrupted block. Pick your time and commit.
setup.pomodoro: A little rhythm goes a long way. Focus, rest, repeat.
guard.label: Hold this workspace
guard.hint: Leaving during focus brings you back. Breaks set you free.
guard.break: Workspace released. Your next focus block starts automatically.
sites.label: Block social media
sites.setupHint: Blocking works in every browser through /etc/hosts. Allow it once with your password; Lock-In never asks again.
sites.hint: Each site includes its www. and mobile addresses.
active.intention: You made time. Make it count.
active.focusHint: Nothing to adjust. Just the work in front of you.
active.breakHint: Step away. Stretch. Come back with a clear head.
finished.hint: Take a moment. Your next block can wait.
unlock.hint: Need to leave? Type UNLOCK to end this session early. It will be recorded as interrupted.
help.keys:
Space · Start    Tab / Shift+Tab · Move focus
Enter · Activate    Esc · Close    ? · Shortcuts
help.limits: No pause. No skipping. A long break follows every fourth focus round if another round remains. The workspace guard is a commitment aid. Social media blocking stops new visits during focus; tabs already open may keep working, so close them.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Check the Lock-In service logs.
error.runtime_unavailable: Lock-In cannot access the session runtime directory. Check XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and its permissions.
error.hyprland_unavailable: Workspace guard unavailable. Check that Hyprland is running.
error.workspace_unavailable: Choose a regular workspace before starting a guarded session.
error.already_active: A session is already in progress.
error.invalid_duration: Choose a duration within the field limits.
error.confirmation_required: Type UNLOCK exactly to end the session.
error.state_unreadable: Saved state could not be read. Back up and repair ~/.local/state/lockin/state.json before retrying.
error.state_unwritable: Cannot save the session. Check available disk space and state directory permissions.
error.service_already_running: Another Lock-In service is already running.
error.invalid_response: Lock-In returned an invalid response. Reconnecting…
error.service_failed: Lock-In could not start. Check the service logs.
error.sites_setup_required: Allow social media blocking first, or turn it off.
error.sites_setup_failed: Blocking was not allowed. Try again when you're ready.
error.sites_unavailable: Could not update the social media block. Retrying shortly.
error.invalid_site: Enter a site like reddit.com or paste a link.
error.too_many_sites: You can block up to 100 sites.
notice.focus: Time to focus. Your work block has started.
notice.break: Good work. Take a break; your workspace is free.
